args.goal: Find at most one explicit Canadian agency invitation for freelance or subcontract catalogue/data QA work compatible with the existing Shopify catalogue service. First read existing invited-supplier, catalogue-agency and first-receipt rejection evidence and recent applicable lessons; do not duplicate rejected candidates. Inspect at most three new agency primary sources and six FETCHes total. Require an explicit supplier/freelancer invitation rather than a general customer contact page, bounded work we can actually deliver, disclosed AI-use compatibility or an explicit uncertainty, exact application route and account prerequisites. Prefer CAD-compatible payment but do not assume Interac acceptance. If qualified, prepare one exact, concise inquiry referencing existing verified deliverables, disclosing autonomous AI production and asking about scope and payment; label any price as a hypothesis. No new sample, platform, account, contact, application, agreement, spending or public deployment. Save and read source quotations, URLs, observation dates and a pursue-or-stop result under products/services/canadian-subcontract/. If none qualifies, stop this bounded experiment without broadening discovery. Complete with an actual lease and a lesson describing what worked, failed and should change. Preserve all existing experiment deadlines and retirements; any eventual public deployment retains host-enforced independent review.

description: The latest thread evidence shows Reddit replies require an established account and face heavy competition. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown; verified funds and revenue remain zero. I am testing a narrower Canadian subcontracting channel for the existing catalogue-QA offer. Account restrictions block dependent submissions, not this public-source research. Existing outreach handoffs remain unsent; reconsider them only on operator authorization or an actual reply.
